notes: Nulls the companion field aLongArray8800 (a 32-element LongArray). Contains a decoy-like self-recursive branch `if (i < 27) method2614(42)`; the only call site is Client.kt:1192, `method2614(i.toInt() xor 0x4d)`, where the argument depends on a runtime Byte parameter of the enclosing reset routine rather than a fixed literal, so unlike most sibling reset methods in this codebase this branch is not provably dead - however since the recursive call always passes the literal 42 (>= 27), at most one extra no-op reset occurs and there is no risk of unbounded recursion. Part of the same large per-subsystem state-reset sequence in Client.kt as MaterialTypeMarker.method2613 (called two lines later with -1).
